verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Trello's core board/list/card layout ([trello-docs-9], [trello-comm-19]) and a calendar-sync feature for allocating time slots ([trello-docs-2]). Nothing shows switchable alternate views of the same board's work, and timeline is never mentioned. missing for 10: evidence of switching views on the same work, a timeline view, a distinct list/table view, a calendar view of board cards (not just calendar sync), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
